text.default: Hello! Welcome to the clothes shop. Would you like to see our shirts?
We have {menu}. Which color would you like?
{item} costs ${price}. Would you like to order it?
You chose the {order}. The total is ${total}. Would you like to confirm and pay?
Thank you! You paid ${total}. Here is your {order}. I have added it to My items and you are wearing it now.
Your order is cancelled. You have not been charged. Which shirt would you like instead?
The shirt costs ${total}, but you do not have enough money. You have not been charged. Would you like to cancel?
That shirt or its price has changed. You have not been charged. Please ask to see the shirts again.
There is no shirt to confirm. Would you like to see our shirts?
Goodbye! Any unpaid order is cancelled. Have a lovely day!
Please ask the receptionist at the station information desk for a bus ticket. Where would you like to go?
Would you like to see our shirts, ask about a color, or order one? Your current order stays unchanged.
